title: arctostaphylos viscida subsp. mariposa
intro: Arctostaphylos viscida subsp. mariposa, commonly known as Mariposa Manzanita, is a species of flowering plant in the heath family, Ericaceae. It is a woody shrub native to the Sierra Nevada mountain range in California, United States. Mariposa Manzanita is valued for its medicinal properties, offering potential health benefits such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities, which may aid in wound healing and immune system support. The plant contains bioactive constituents like phenolic acids, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial effects.
